column1: Palay and Corn: Volume of Production in Metric Tons by Ecosystem/Croptype, Quarter, Semester, Region and Province, 1987-2026

Definition: Quantity produced and actually harvested for a particular crop during the reference period. It includes those harvested but damaged, stolen, given away, consumed, given as harvester's share, reserved, etc. Production from seed growers is exluded from the survey.
Method of Computation: Palay and Corn Quarterly Bulletin Technical Notes
Level of Disaggregation: National, Regional, Provincial, and Selected Cities

Note/s: .. Data not applicable; a/ - Still part of Western Visayas prior to 2024; b/ - Still part of Central Visayas prior to 2024; c/ - Still part of BARMM prior to 2026. In accordance with Excecutive Order No. 91, Sulu is realigned to Region IX; d/ - The 2026 data of BARMM excludes the province of Sulu due to Executive Order No. 91; Q2 2022 - Revised data for Upland Palay in Davao del Norte; Q2 2023 - Revised data for Yellow Corn in Lanao del Sur; Q3 2022 - Revised data for Rainfed Palay in Occidental Mindoro; Q1 2025 - Revised data for Rainfed Palay in Negros Orccidental and Negros Oriental; Negros Occidental, Negros Oriental, and Siquijor are included in Negros Island Region (NIR) starting 2025; Q2 2025 - Revised data for Irrigated Palay in BARMM; Q1 2026 - Revised data for Irrigated Palay in Lanao del Norte, Rainfed Palay in Aklan and Antique, White Corn in Pampanga and Misamis Oriental, Yellow Corn for Antique; Q3 2026 - Preliminary

The sample coverage for BARMM includes provinces of Maguindanao del Sur and Maguindanao del Norte (previously Province of Maguindanao), Cotabato City and the eight cluster areas (63 barangays, previously from Province of Cotabato).
TOTAL of BARMM starting Q1 2023 is not equal to the sum of provinces as the estimates of the Eight Cluster Areas is already included in the total estimate of BARMM.
